title: Peña Nieto Photographed With Israeli Businessman Accused of $25M Pegasus-Linked Bribes
detail: Enrique Peña Nieto was photographed at Israeli singer Omer Adam's wedding to Sacha Israelovich in Portofino, Italy on August 25, 2026, alongside Israeli businessman Avishai Neriah. Neriah — appointed honorary consul of Mexico in Haifa in 2014 — was named in a 2025 investigation by Israeli outlet TheMarker alleging he and business partner Uri Ansbacher allocated $25 million between 2012 and 2018 to secure Mexican government contracts, with documents describing a 'joint investment' and 'direct access' to Peña Nieto; the reporting tied the dealings to the NSO Group's Pegasus spyware, though it did not specify Neriah's precise role in the Pegasus contracts. Neither Peña Nieto nor Neriah commented on the encounter, which surfaced in Mexican media around August 30. Peña Nieto had previously called the 2025 TheMarker allegations 'totally false' and 'reckless and malicious.'
